sam: FYI i saw a cluster of /v1/embeddings slow calls this morning around 04:05 UTC. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~780ms for a short window. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/embeds/problem-heatmap :confused:

ops-bot: ALERT: embeddings.backend.p95 > 700ms for 3m — impacted tenants: 17 (highest: partner-y)

jordan: any PID/trace samples? could be sudden influx of high-dimension vectors or a change in batching behavior

sam: attached sanitized traces: `t-3f2b`, `t-3f33`. most requests reported dims around 2048 or unspecified. payloads often ~1.6MB. routing logs show more router fallbacks to slow path under load

vira: 2k dims is heavy but our runtime should handle it if batching and kv-cache are warm. suspect two compounding issues: (1) we tag metrics with exact dims (high cardinality), (2) preflight/header hints missing -> router hesitates to pick proper kernel/pool

jordan: we need to fix both: reduce cardinality for metrics and push clients to send a dim hint header. propose these work items: telemetry bucketing, conservative sampling of traces, and SDK header tilt with console warning

sam: for bucketing, suggest boundaries: tiny (<=32), small (33-128), medium (129-512), large (513-2048), jumbo (>2048). different than earlier proposals because a lot of legacy clients send 2048 and we want to isolate them

vira: sampling plan: keep deterministic counters for billing (always increment units). For detailed histograms/traces: stratified sampling per bucket with these rates: tiny=5%, small=3%, medium=1%, large=0.5%, jumbo=0.1%. Rationale: larger dims are rarer but more impactful so sample a bit to capture latency profile without exploding ingestion

jordan: make sure sampling decision uses tenant-consistent hashing so we can replay stable samples for a tenant over time. avoid totally random sampling that hides tenant regressions

sam: agreed. implementation: sample_key = hash(tenant_id + request_id + sampling_version) % 10000 < threshold[bucket]

ops-bot: NOTE: changing metrics labels will require updating panels and alerts. Current queries use `group by (embed_dim)`; after change use `group by (dim_bucket)` or join with `dim_histogram`

vira: telemetry tag names: `dim_bucket`, `client_hint` (values: `sdk_hint`, `preflight_none`, `sniffed`), `sampling_ver` (v2, v3...). keep label value sets bounded to avoid cardinality blowup

jordan: SDK plan: add optional header `x-rwd-embed-dim-hint` in next minor. console will show a banner for tenants without hints for 30 days. enforcement window for dedicated/private in 8 weeks

sam: dashboard tasks: create a new panel that shows request rate and p95 split by `dim_bucket` + a heatmap tenant vs bucket. also add an annotation series when we flip feature flag `embeds.telemetry.v2`

vira: alerts: do not keep global p95 threshold. create per-bucket rolling baselines (7d) and alert if p95 > baseline + 3*stdev OR > baseline*1.4 (whichever triggers first). start in mute-mode for canary rollout then go live

jordan: rollout: feature-flagged at ingress. Canary group = 5% tenants (low-latency percentiles) for 48h, then 25% for 48h, then 100% if stable. Telemetry transform in metrics pipeline will map numeric dims -> bucket label; keep a debug export for 0.1% of events with raw numeric dim for calibration

sam: note on quotas: counts used for quota enforcement must remain exact. do not derive quota units from sampled telemetry. emit `embed.units` counters always and sum them in billing path. only traces/histograms are sampled

vira: infra ask: metrics pipeline team needs a lightweight transform to convert `embed.dim` int -> `dim_bucket` string and drop the numeric tag to reduce series. also need an option to keep numeric in a sparse debug topic (0.1% events)

ops-bot: WARNING: existing PromQL dashboards referencing `embed_dim` will break. Owners please open PRs to update queries to new label names within 48h of canary start

jordan: testing: add a synthetic load in `eng-platform/embeds/e2e-sim` that emits mixed dims including >2048 to validate sampling rates and dashboard panels. include a unit test asserting counters = sum(est_units) across sampled and unsampled streams

sam: owners: i'll own SDK docs + console badge (owner: sam). Jordan will own dashboard + alert changes (owner: jordan). Vira will implement sampling + metrics transform (owner: vira). Lin will validate billing/quota path (owner: lin). ops will coordinate canary schedule (ops-bot)

vira: nits: add a `client_hint=sniffed` bucket for requests where we had to peek payload to infer dims; metric label values must be only `sdk_hint|preflight_none|sniffed`

lin: audit note: we should run a backfill of 14 days to compute per-bucket baselines before we enable live alerts. telemetry pipeline should export a CSV with baseline stats for review

jordan: i'll draft a short RFC + sequence diagram (client -> ingress(tag + counters) -> router -> runtime -> metrics-transform -> grafana). will attach by EOD tomorrow

sam: timeline: RFC and dashboard PR this week, canary next Wed, full rollout after 2 weeks of stable telemetry. any objections?

lin: +1. also please coordinate with billing to confirm cost delta from sampling and metric cardinality reduction

vira: thanks everyone. i'll start the infra branch with sampling hooks and add the tenant-consistent sampling util. will ping when ready for canary config

sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
